bagPolicy.summary: Small clear bags up to 12"x6"x12" and clutches are allowed, while large bags are prohibited.
bagPolicy.note: Unity Arena entry and bag limits are event-specific. Review the official event page before arrival and bring only essential items for screening.

parking.note: Parking and public-transport arrangements vary by event at Unity Arena. Review the official event and visitor information before travelling to Fornebu.

rideshare.note: A dedicated rideshare zone was not confirmed in Unity Arena's current published guidance. Follow the event page and your rideshare app on show day, and use only signed pickup or drop-off areas.

concessions.note: The Food Court at Aker Tech House offers a diverse selection of cuisines from around the world, prepared in an open kitchen with live flames. It serves as a lunch destination for both locals and visitors, featuring flavorful dishes from four unique cuisines.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: If you have specific accommodation needs, contact the arena before buying tickets. For concerts, reserve wheelchair and companion seats through Ticketmaster.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: Re-entry is not allowed. If you leave the event, you cannot come back in.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Use the ticket provider's mobile app to scan your ticket at entry.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Use the entrance printed on your ticket. If one order includes both entrances 9 and 14, your whole group can enter together at either one.
